name: smajl-marketplace
description: Jan Pesa's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — skills, agents, and commands shared across machines.

plugins.name: harvest-log
plugins.description: Reconstruct a workday from git, GitLab, Jira, Google Calendar, Granola and Slack, then log it to Harvest after you confirm.

plugins.name: harvest-review
plugins.description: Review your team's logged Harvest time for irregularities — miscategorised work, repeated filler notes, bulk backdating — and verify the flags against GitLab and Jira.
